title: A blocking gate answered by the orchestrator that corrects the item's repro lets the repro be replaced by a command that passes on the fixed tree
goal: set --repro accepts, in a worker's worktree, a command that passes now when the item has an answered gate whose answer corrects the repro (the worker's own fix makes the corrected command pass), so a worker does not stop with a repro that asserts what the answer dropped and the orchestrator does not rebuild the item on a detached base checkout
